name: Transparency
definition: The AI system's purpose, logic, data sources, limitations, and decision-making processes are clearly disclosed to relevant stakeholders.

name: Explainability
definition: The AI system's outputs and the factors influencing them can be explained in a way understandable to the intended audience.

name: Reproducibility
definition: The AI system's results and behaviours can be consistently reproduced under the same conditions; development and test artefacts are traceable and auditable.

name: Safety
definition: The AI system does not endanger human life, health, property, or the environment; risks are identified, assessed, and controlled throughout the lifecycle.

name: Security
definition: The AI system is protected against unauthorised access, adversarial attacks, data poisoning, and other threats that could compromise its integrity or outputs.

name: Robustness
definition: The AI system maintains acceptable performance across varied, unexpected, or adversarial conditions; it degrades gracefully when inputs fall outside training distribution.

name: Fairness
definition: The AI system does not produce unjustified discriminatory outputs or outcomes across demographic groups; bias is identified, measured, and mitigated.

name: Data Governance
definition: Data used to develop, validate, and operate the AI system is managed with appropriate controls for quality, provenance, privacy, access, and lifecycle management.

name: Accountability
definition: Clear roles, responsibilities, and governance structures exist for the AI system's development, deployment, and operation; decisions are traceable and redress mechanisms exist.

name: Human Agency & Oversight
definition: Humans retain meaningful control over AI system decisions; appropriate oversight mechanisms, override capabilities, and escalation paths are in place.

name: Inclusive Growth, Societal & Environmental Wellbeing
definition: The AI system's development and deployment considers broader societal impacts including environmental sustainability, equitable access, and effects on communities beyond direct users.

name: Legal & Ethical Compliance
definition: The AI system's development and use comply with applicable laws, regulations, and ethical standards; prohibited uses are identified and enforced; regulatory obligations are tracked.
